nodes.name: Every 6 hours
nodes.notes: Four runs a day, not every 15 minutes like mail. The free Bank Account Data tier meters calls per account per day, so polling harder gets the account throttled rather than the balance fresher. Minute 7 keeps it off the top of the hour where every other cron fires.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Non-secret shaping only. BANK_REQUISITION_ID identifies the consent you completed in the browser; it is not a credential and cannot be used without the secret pair, which lives in n8n's credential store.

nodes.name: Get access token
nodes.notes: The credential injects {"body":{"secret_id":"...","secret_key":"..."}} into this POST, so the pair never appears in this file. Minting a fresh 24h access token on every run is deliberate: at four runs a day the refresh-token dance buys nothing and would mean persisting a second secret somewhere. Repoint this node at your own credential; the id here is a placeholder.

nodes.name: Fetch requisition
nodes.notes: Returns the account ids the consent covers. An expired consent answers 200 with an empty accounts array, not an error - handled in 'Split accounts'.

nodes.name: Fetch details
nodes.notes: onError continues so one account that the bank refuses does not take the other accounts' balances down with it.

nodes.name: Fetch balances
nodes.notes: The account id comes from 'Split accounts' through pairedItem, because the previous node replaced $json with the details response.

meta.notes: Open-banking fetch for the `bank` widget, via GoCardless Bank Account Data (the former Nordigen free AIS tier). CREDENTIAL RULE: the secret_id/secret_key pair lives only in n8n's encrypted credential store. Jytte holds no bank credential and has no Python client - the widget is source: n8n. Before activating: create the consent in a browser once (see app/widgets/bank/CLAUDE.md), put the resulting requisition id in BANK_REQUISITION_ID, add the httpCustomAuth credential and repoint 'Get access token' at it. The consent expires after 90 days by default and must be redone - stale_days in the payload is what surfaces that.
